items.why_it_matters: 汉译早期长篇经集，是跨传统比较早期佛教的重要入口。
items.relation_note: Chinese Dīrgha Āgama collection; compare discourse-by-discourse with Dīgha Nikāya and other parallels rather than treating the collections as identical.

items.why_it_matters: 适合和巴利《中部》逐经对读，观察共同核心与版本差异。
items.relation_note: Chinese Madhyama Āgama; many individual discourses have parallels in the Majjhima Nikāya and elsewhere.

items.why_it_matters: 研究缘起、五蕴、无我等早期教义时的核心汉译资料。
items.relation_note: Chinese Saṃyukta Āgama; closely comparable at discourse/group level with the Saṃyutta Nikāya.

items.why_it_matters: 能直接看见“按数字组织教法”这一古老记忆技术。
items.relation_note: Chinese Ekottarika Āgama; not a simple one-to-one equivalent of the Pāli Aṅguttara Nikāya.

items.title_en: Setting the Dhamma Wheel in Motion
items.why_it_matters: 传统上视为佛陀成道后的第一次正式说法，是理解四谛与中道的起点。
items.relation_note: Pāli recension with parallels in other early Buddhist traditions.

items.why_it_matters: 最直接讨论“五蕴非我”的早期经典之一。
items.relation_note: Pāli recension; early parallels exist across traditions.

items.title_en: The Great Discourse on the Buddha’s Extinguishment
items.why_it_matters: 特别适合做版本比较：不同传承保存了明显不同的增删与编排。
items.relation_note: Pāli version of an early parinirvāṇa cycle; extant parallels differ substantially in places. Do not confuse with the later Mahāyāna Mahāparinirvāṇa Sūtra.

items.why_it_matters: 现代 mindfulness 讨论绕不开，但应回到古典语境而不是只看现代减压版本。
items.relation_note: Pāli recension; related material appears in other early traditions and in DN 22.

items.why_it_matters: 经常被现代人概括成“不要相信任何权威”，实际文本比口号复杂得多。
items.relation_note: Pāli text often simplified in modern quotation; context matters.

items.title_zh: 善生经 / 教授尸伽罗越经（巴利对应）
items.why_it_matters: 非常适合现代大众：讲家庭、朋友、雇佣关系、财富和社会责任。
items.relation_note: Pāli recension with Chinese parallels; titles and framing differ by tradition.

items.why_it_matters: 短、可读、适合小白直接进入早期佛教的慈心训练。
items.relation_note: Pāli text preserved in more than one Pāli collection context.

items.why_it_matters: 最适合做“同一句格言在不同语言传统里如何变化”的入口。
items.relation_note: The Pāli Dhammapada and Chinese 法句 collections are related verse traditions, not one mechanically identical text.

items.why_it_matters: 短篇般若经典的代表，也是最适合展示梵/汉/藏多版本对读的经典之一。
items.relation_note: Chinese and Tibetan translations belong to the wider Vajracchedikā textual tradition; Sanskrit witnesses also survive.

items.why_it_matters: 全球最知名佛经之一，非常适合用来教“作品、版本、译本、写本不是同一层”。
items.relation_note: Multiple Sanskrit, Chinese and Tibetan witnesses/recensions; short and long forms are part of the textual history.

items.why_it_matters: 东亚影响巨大，同时保留梵文、汉文、藏文证据，适合做完整传播史案例。
items.relation_note: Several Chinese translations/recensions survive; T262 is Kumārajīva’s influential translation.

items.why_it_matters: 故事性极强，几乎天然适合做连续剧式内容。
items.relation_note: Multiple Chinese translations and a Tibetan version survive; Sanskrit manuscript evidence is also important for modern study.

items.title_zh: 大方广佛华严经（八十华严）
items.why_it_matters: 最能展示“宏大佛教宇宙叙事”和大型集合文本如何形成。
items.relation_note: Chinese T279 and Tibetan Toh 44 represent large Avataṃsaka collections whose internal organization is not simply one-to-one.

items.why_it_matters: 非常适合展示“同一文本跨印度—中国—西藏后，细节如何变化”。
items.relation_note: Shorter Sukhāvatī text with extant Sanskrit, Chinese and Tibetan versions; versions vary in details.

items.why_it_matters: 阿弥陀佛本愿与净土思想的重要文本源头之一。
items.relation_note: Longer Sukhāvatī tradition; multiple Chinese translations survive and should be compared as separate versions.

items.why_it_matters: “名字看起来一样但其实不是同一层文本”的经典教学案例。
items.relation_note: Later Mahāyāna parinirvāṇa scripture; do not conflate with the early Pāli DN 16 despite similar English/Chinese naming.

items.why_it_matters: 禅宗与唯识相关讨论的重要文本，也很适合做多译本差异。
items.relation_note: Several Chinese translations and Tibetan witnesses survive; internal recensional complexity is significant.

items.why_it_matters: 84000 对它的版本研究本身就是“如何做佛典文本批判”的优秀范例。
items.relation_note: Complete extant recensions survive in Chinese and Tibetan; Sanskrit survives fragmentarily/reconstructively in parts.

items.why_it_matters: 帮助用户理解“大藏经中的一部大经”有时本身就是一个文集。
items.relation_note: Large anthology/collection; Chinese and Tibetan collection structures are related but not a single one-to-one volume.

items.why_it_matters: 最能说明“Collection-level crosswalk”和“单一作品 crosswalk”必须分开。
items.relation_note: Xuanzang’s enormous Chinese compilation is not a one-to-one equivalent of a single Tibetan work; map component works individually.

items.title_en: Fundamental Verses on the Middle Way
items.why_it_matters: 不是“佛经”狭义 sūtra，而是后世理解空与中观的核心论典。
items.relation_note: Chinese Madhyamaka treatise associated with Nāgārjuna; compare Sanskrit and Tibetan witnesses separately.

items.why_it_matters: 理解佛教“分析心理学/宇宙论/业论”体系化过程的重要桥梁。
items.relation_note: Systematic scholastic treatise by Vasubandhu; not a sūtra and should be separated from Buddha-word collections.

items.why_it_matters: 展示后期佛教如何把修行、心理和认识论做成巨大系统工程。
items.relation_note: Large Yogācāra scholastic corpus with complex composition history.

items.title_en: Cheng Weishi Lun / Demonstration of Consciousness-Only
items.why_it_matters: 非常适合解释“翻译”有时其实包含编纂、综合和学派建构。
items.relation_note: Xuanzang’s Chinese synthesis drawing on multiple Indian Yogācāra commentarial sources; not simply a translation of one surviving Sanskrit book.

items.title_en: Awakening of Faith in the Mahāyāna
items.why_it_matters: 非常适合网站展示“传统归属”和“现代学术争议”可以同时存在。
items.relation_note: Traditionally attributed to Aśvaghoṣa and translated by Paramārtha; origin/authorship have long been debated in modern scholarship.

items.why_it_matters: 用来教学‘受传统尊崇’与‘文本来源有争议’并不互相排斥。
items.relation_note: Highly influential in East Asia; questions about provenance and the absence of a securely identified Indic source are central to modern discussions.

items.title_en: Platform Sūtra of the Sixth Patriarch
items.why_it_matters: 它不是印度传来的佛经，却成为东亚佛教最重要文本之一，直接打破‘佛经=印度翻译经’的误解。
items.relation_note: Chinese Chan scripture associated with Huineng; multiple historical recensions survive, including Dunhuang and later received forms.

items.title_zh: 方广大庄严经 / 普曜经（相关汉译）
items.why_it_matters: 故事性强，适合做‘佛陀生平是如何被不同文本逐层叙事化’。
items.relation_note: Buddha-biography textual tradition preserved in Sanskrit, Tibetan and Chinese versions/related translations.
